Hot Tub Maintenance

The CDC's hot tub numbers are free chlorine of at least 3 ppm or bromine of 4 to 8 ppm, pH between 7.0 and 7.8, and water no hotter than 104°F. Test before you soak, shock after heavy use, rinse the filter every week or two, deep-clean it monthly, and drain and refill every few months, following your owner's manual for your model.

Swipe for the details. The full guide, with every source linked, is at the link in bio.
